registration_rule.shared_renderer: one generic path for every slot object: $220E -> $3FC8 -> $226A -> $22B6
registration_rule.other_sat_writers: none: every reference to $D36F/$D371 in the whole ROM lies inside $220E..$2334

equations.sat_x_word: anchor_x - cam_x + x_origin' + piece_x'   ($22B6; flip negates x_origin and uses the +$0D08 mirrored table)
equations.sat_x_clip: high byte != 0 -> SAT X byte = 0   ($2306..$230C); R0 bit 5 blanks columns 0..7

consequence.y: a sprite pixel with mapping row m appears at terrain-space row anchor_y + y_origin + m + 1 + 17 = anchor_y + y_origin + m + 18
consequence.x: a sprite pixel with mapping column m appears at terrain-space column anchor_x + x_origin' + m + 1
consequence.object_anchor_space: object anchors are terrain-space minus (1, 18); the collision floor probe adds the same 18 at $7690
